notes.title: LAN Party Patch #7
notes.content:
Fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed issue where streams would sometimes freeze on the first frame.
[/list]

notes.title: LAN Party Patch #6
notes.content:
Fixes:

[list]
[*] Room invites will now display correctly in the rooms menu.
[*] You can now interact with monitors while sitting in front of them.
[/list]

notes.title: LAN Party Patch #5
notes.content:
Fixes:

[list]
[*] If a player joins a room with other players who are sitting, they will correctly appear as sitting.
[*] Room Settings menu no longer appears for users who don't own the room.
[*] Various small UI fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: LAN Party Patch #4
notes.content:
Fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed issue where newly created/joined rooms weren't loading.
[*] "Recent" rooms list now updates correctly.
[*] Players can now join rooms directly from a different room.
[/list]

notes.title: LAN Party Patch #3
notes.content:
Fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a few glitched icons in Marketplace.
[*] Fixed issue where players could get stuck in desk when standing up.
[/list]

notes.title: LAN Party Patch #2
notes.content:
Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed audio streaming bug preventing some users from streaming.
[*] Fixed issue where streams of certain applications would freeze on the first frame.
[/list]

notes.title: LAN Party Patch #1
notes.content:
New Features:
[list]
[*] When streaming an application to the room, you can now stream the audio from the application as well. To toggle this on/off, click on the stream preview in the bottom right corner of the screen.
[*] You can now invite Steam friends to rooms even if they don't yet have LAN Party.
[*] Added audio output source selection in Settings -> Audio.
[/list]
Improvements:
[list]
[*] Greatly improved loading times and menu/UI responsiveness.
[/list]
